steps.name: Orbital Turmoil
steps.objective: Talk to Shino in "Midgard", then go to the "Space Shuttle Station".

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: I've heard the broad outline of what happened. I'll take the princess back to Aoich once she has recovered.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Understood.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: You seem deeply troubled. I'm afraid I can't tell you what to make of the path you're on.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: What will you do now? Didn't you have something you were originally pursuing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes. Finding Iris...

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: Ah, Lady Iris... I can't tell you where she is now, but I can tell you where she went.
(Shino points upward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Up? The ceiling? Oh, the sky.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: I remember her discussing it while dining here with her companions. They said that if they went up into the sky and met the Aesir, they might learn something...

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: They were full of determination. I also remember them meeting someone named Siam here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Aesir...

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: They brought science to Jiendia, including Midgard. Some of Midgard's residents are descended from the Aesir themselves.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I get there?

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: I'm not certain, but try going to the very top of Bifrost. I hear there's a machine there that can take you into space, where the Aesir live.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then I'll go right away. Thank you for telling me.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: You're welcome. At least have something to eat before... Already gone.

lines.speaker: 시노
lines.text: ...Somehow, I feel that adventurer may find Lady Iris before long...

steps.name: Hello Across the Void?!
steps.objective: Talk to [Scylla], then go to the Hangar and defeat [Garter].

lines.text: (As you make your way inside Bifrost, an enormous spacecraft comes into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, it really exists. Can I get to Asgard just by boarding that?
(You sense someone nearby. A girl spots %s and recoils with an exaggerated look of surprise.)
Oh! A person, in a place like this...! I, Branch Manager Scylla, simply cannot believe it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: Oh, have you come to take the spacecraft to Asgard?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. But can it really take me there?

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: Of course, dear customer! At last, after 16795%% hours, 32 minutes, and 33 seconds since arriving here, we can finally leave!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How many hours?!

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: Never mind that!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How am I supposed to ignore that...?)

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: The shuttle to Asgard will depart shortly! All passengers, please board immediately!

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: Scylla will be happy to show you the way!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She really does seem delighted.)

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: Oh, why are you looking at me like that? Never seen an alien with octopus legs before?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It is my first time seeing an alien with octopus legs, but I was looking because you seemed so happy, Scylla.

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: Hehe. I really am.

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: You've seen strange monsters, a bird covered in flames, and even dragons. Surely a girl with octopus legs isn't that surprising?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Haha...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do you know I've met those beings?

lines.speaker: 스큐라
lines.text: Ahaha... The space shuttle is departing! Dear passenger, enjoy a comfortable journey to your destination. That's all from Scylla!
(Scylla's announcement wishing you a safe journey echoes through the shuttle. Once it stops, the doors open with a resounding noise.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is Asgard...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like a small spacecraft attached to an enormous one...
Ahem. An understandable impression!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Scylla? How are you here?

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: I may bear a resemblance, but I am not Scylla! Do you mean the beautiful, innocent young lady at Bifrost Station?

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: Then you have the wrong person!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look like Scylla no matter which way I turn.

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: Ahem! In what way?! A cute, lovely young girl like her could hardly have a magnificent, dignified mustache like this!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...That's true.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Besides, if you were her, you would have crossed space faster than the spacecraft to get here.

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: Flinch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Flinch?

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: Ahem! Nothing! It's all your imagination! Hehe. Well, I hope your business in Asgard goes well.

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: Getting here was so exhausting that I think I need a rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, rest well. But where should I go to meet someone else?

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: Follow the path farther inside, and you will meet someone named Ishtar!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll be going, then.

lines.speaker: 스큐라?
lines.text: Oh! It'll be easier if you destroy the broken mechs along the way. I mean, it shall be easier!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That tone changed for a moment...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What happened to this place?
(The being who looks like Scylla...? avoids answering %s, stepping back and waving.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You seem to be saying something... What was that? Just go and see?
(From a distance, Scylla...? nods.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Whew. No choice, then. Shall I go find this Ishtar...?

steps.name: An Ally in Asgard
steps.objective: Talk to [Ishtar] in the "Isolation Room", then defeat [Fenrir].

lines.text: (Beyond a crowd of mechs, you see a passage leading somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That must be it. But what's that sound...? This is...
(Click, whirr. The mechanical noise comes from the floor, where pieces of a seemingly destroyed machine lie scattered.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, these are remains of the mechs I saw here. Was there a battle just now...? I can smell something like scorched shells.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And there are signs of a fight with monsters...
Who is there? I don't recognize that voice...
(Farther inside, you see a woman wearing unusual armor. A moment later, she approaches, hovering with its support.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
Stop. Make one suspicious move and I'll turn you to dust. Sarasvati, what is it?
(Beside the woman, someone called Sarasvati appears faintly, like a hologram.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Ishtar, wait a moment. That person isn't a surface dweller. The system is in confusion. It may be the same as last time.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: When that man Siam came?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Who are you? Who are you to cause errors here? Your very existence is suspicious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you say Siam? Iris's companion?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: You know him too? Iris... That's a name I haven't heard in a while. So, why are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain to Ishtar that you came here to find out where Iris went.)

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: So you're the anomaly Sarasvati noticed a little while ago.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It is certainly strange that an unrecognized presence has become recognizable. However, the system now recommends that we trust this person...

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: An adventurer searching for Iris... No, perhaps Iris called you herself...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Even if we explained, you wouldn't understand it right away.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Ah, Sarasvati.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes, Sister.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: I'll do as you suggest, Sarasvati. You—what's your name?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Good. We, the Asgard Defense Force, welcome you as an <ally>. I am Ishtar, commander of Asgard's defensive line.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: You may call me Miss Ishtar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Miss Ishtar. It's a pleasure. But an ally?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: I ask for your cooperation, even if only briefly. In return, you should be able to reach what you're seeking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help. What should I do?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Beings from an unknown place are causing trouble here. I've been investigating, and your arrival has brought about a slight change.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: I can't say exactly what it is, but that's how things stand. Right now, I need to examine the systems around here.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: So I'd like to ask you a favor. Would you retrace your steps and take another look along the way?

steps.name: Codename: Elmei
steps.objective: 1. Meet [Broken Belt] in the "Hangar" and hear about [Ishtar].\n2. Talk to [Ishtar] in the "Isolation Room", then return to [Broken Belt] and talk again.

lines.text: (In the distance, you see a motionless mech. As though sensing your approach, it struggles to start up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's broken, so it may be safe... It feels different from the ones that went berserk...)

lines.speaker: 부서진 벨트
lines.text: Kzzzt... Unidentifiable entity approaching.

lines.speaker: 부서진 벨트
lines.text: Neither a being of Asgard nor a monster from another world...

lines.speaker: 부서진 벨트
lines.text: Similar to Lord Siam... Kzzzt... Who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It recognizes me? Oh, is this what Ishtar wanted me to check...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm looking for Iris...

lines.speaker: 부서진 벨트
lines.text: You mean Lady Iris, who came with Lord Siam. Kzzzt...

lines.speaker: 부서진 벨트
lines.text: Creating temporary account. Registering target account provisionally under [Ally]... I am identification number SB7-37, a Belt-type Angel. Please call me [Elmay]. Kzzzt...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nice to meet you, Elmay. I'm %s... Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Kzzzt... After prolonged combat, I am approaching my limits. Kzzzt... As a prototype, in my current condition I could cease functioning at any time...

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Is Lady Ishtar all right? Kzzzt... At some point, monsters began appearing from an unknown source... I fought against their attacks, which were certainly no coincidence, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Miss Ishtar is all right. Oh, Elmay. I'll take you to her.

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Kzzzt... My weight is approximately three times yours, %s... Please do not overexert yourself...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything I can do to help?

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Kzzzt... Kind, just like those people... Then could you ask Lady Ishtar for an AI Booster and bring it to me?

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: It is equipment that extends my preservation functions for a limited period. With it, I can eject my core unit. Lady Ishtar could then repair me. Kzzzt...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go right away.

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Kzzzt... I see Lady Iris's face in yours, %s... I also recall her companion, Lord Siam...

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Kzzzt...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please, don't push yourself. I'll be right back!

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: If I... recover... As they once stood beside me... I too will... for you...

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: %s, did anything happen?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Ishtar about Elmay.)

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Elmay! Thank goodness. Still alive... What a relief. A veteran of so many battles at my side...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's incredible.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: The incident two years ago...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Two years ago...?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Has it already been that long...? Because of that incident, we went from maintaining about five thousand Belts to producing twenty thousand.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: We have to protect this place. Otherwise, the danger could spread beyond it, even to Jiendia...

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Elmay is an early model—number 37, in fact. Oh, right. You said Elmay needed something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. An AI Booster.
(The moment Ishtar hears this, she places something that looks like an AI Booster in your hand.)

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Please make sure it reaches Elmay. Elmay was my mother's Angel. Both Mother and I were very fond of that one. So special that we gave Elmay a name ourselves.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Like... a sister. I want so much to see Elmay again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I know how much Elmay means to you, I'll hurry. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Thank you...

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Kzzzt...

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Kzzzt... Time has run out. There was an error of approximately 147 seconds...

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: How unfortunate. This is strange. Ah... This should not be a system error.

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: This state that I sense within my system...

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Would humans call it fear? Or sadness...?

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Or perhaps... loneliness...

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Is this what humans call emotion?

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Kzzzt...

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: %s, I regret that we will not meet again. I should have... thanked you...

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Kzzzt... Kzzzt...

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Kzzzt... Though it is impossible, I wish to see my former masters... Lady Ishtar's parents...

lines.speaker: 엘메이
lines.text: Kzzzt... I would tell them how splendidly Lady Ishtar has grown... Kzzzt... Make them proud...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I'm back, Elmay...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elmay...?
(Elmay is motionless. Even the strained voice that seemed to long for former masters has fallen silent.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I'm too late...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth happened here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to know. About Iris, and about this place...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's this...?
(A small chip lies in front of Elmay.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what it is. I'll take it to Miss Ishtar... Elmay...

steps.name: Cross World (1)
steps.objective: 1. Talk to [Ishtar] in the "Isolation Room", then defeat [Kerberus] at the "Hydroponic Farm".\n2. Find [Freya] in the "Isolation Room". Then defeat [Loki] wandering around "D-Lab" and obtain <Loki's Black Feather>.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Thank you, %s. But why that expression?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Elmay...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Ishtar that Elmay has stopped functioning, then hand over the chip you found nearby.)
(Ishtar looks so shaken that she cannot speak.)

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Elmay... Elmay is...

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: I'm sorry. And thank you... Once this is over, I'll go and retrieve Elmay's remains myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Miss Ishtar.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: ...I hate this situation. There's not even time to grieve... I have to keep defeating the monsters that appear and repair the broken mechs.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Sarasvati is looking for the cause, but I don't know how long it will take.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Miss Ishtar? What should I do now?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Sorry, give me a moment. I have a message to send.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll wait.
(Ishtar begins speaking, apparently sending a message somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Freya... Is everything all right there? Everything's fine? There's just a slight problem...?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Stop talking nonsense. I asked whether everything was all right. Why are you only telling me now? Even if the timing was awkward...

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Whew... Listen, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Sarasvati and Freya say they have something to tell you. Would you go see them? While you're on the way, could you also deal with the farm mechs rampaging in the Hydroponic Farm...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can do that right away.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Freya can be a handful, and she may keep you talking for ages. Feel free to cut her off. Sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What Sarasvati wants to tell me...

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: It's probably about the one you're searching for...
(An enormous explosion rings out from the direction of the Hydroponic Farm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'd better hurry. I'll hear the rest from Sarasvati herself.

lines.speaker: 이슈타르
lines.text: Right...
(Beyond the Hydroponic Farm, you enter another chamber. A playful-looking girl is dancing, apparently unaware of your arrival.)
Jang-jagga-jagga-jagga, jang-jagga-jagga-jagga! Hmm, a person? Ehehe, a person! ♡
A person! A person! Someone besides Ishtar!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Freya, by any chance?
(The girl suddenly snaps to attention and salutes.)

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Don't just stand there staring—return my salute, please!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want me to salute back?
(Freya looks satisfied as %s awkwardly returns the salute.)

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Hehe!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, Freya...?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: A colony floating in space—who's visiting this place?! In one little corner, we tend to the soul! Keep planting lettuce, however hard the toll! ♬

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Freya, the colony's idol! Freya, the lovelorn warrior! Hidden kindness shining bright—even lifeless mechs fall for me outright! ♬

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: The leading lady, surpassing Ishtar—Freya herself! Ah, that slipped out. ♥

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somehow, those rhymes actually work...

lines.speaker: 지나가던 커돌이
lines.text: Lady Freya, what did you just say...?

lines.speaker: 지나가던 커돌이
lines.text: An idol? Kind? Lovelorn? Mechs falling for you?
(Freya turns the most radiant smile in the world on Kerberus.)

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Keep walking, quietly. Or I'll pull out your memory chip.

lines.speaker: 커돌이
lines.text: Ah, yes! Just a Kerberus passing through!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why is everyone here like this?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right, focus. Freya...

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Yesss!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I dealt with the mechs that were rampaging in the Hydroponic Farm.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Ehehe, thank you! Want a carrot?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, a black carrot? A purple carrot...? N-no, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Tch. You noticed!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you put in that carrot?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Tehe! Well, if you won't eat the carrot, I suppose it can't be helped. I have a favor to ask! ☆ Some strange creatures have appeared on the way to Sarasvati's room.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Loki has appeared in D-Lab!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: I don't know why Loki, a god from another world, is here, but he's causing mischief.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Please catch him first. If you obtain what he's carrying, Sarasvati can determine the cause.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Then you should be able to find the answer you're looking for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Loki, you said?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll look for him, then.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Nyahaha! Have a carrot before you go. It'll give you strength.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you don't have any red carrots, I'll pass. See you later, Freya.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Nyahaha! Okay!

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Come in, Kerberus. Kerberus, Kerberus, this is Freya.

lines.speaker: 다시 돌아온 커돌이
lines.text: Yes! Kerberus reporting back. Lady Freya, what is it?

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Kerberus, dear Kerberus... Have you ever seen a red carrot?

lines.speaker: 다시 돌아온 커돌이
lines.text: Well...

steps.name: Cross World (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Sarasvati] in the "Isolation Room", then find the Mental Resonator in "D-Lab". Afterward, approach the Unknown Boy and Girl.

lines.text: (At the far end of D-Lab, in the center of another compartment, a girl is looking at a holographic screen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You've arrived. I've been waiting. Please stay there for a moment.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Opening the Hyperspace Network... H-E-L-L-O. Welcome.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I am Sarasvati. You are %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, you know me well. About what you said earlier, about surface dwellers...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The spacetime network has been following your accomplishments with great interest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? You've been watching me...?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Though only within Jiendia...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Asgard's technology is incredible.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: There may be more to it than you imagine.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: In that sense, I am the <Hyperspace Network> itself...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Miss Sarasvati, aren't you human?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I was certainly born human... But our people declared that we would abandon our bodies and make the electronic galaxy our domain.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Humans who believed our human bodies no longer held meaning...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's hard to understand. This really is different from the rest of Jiendia. I can see why Atlantis's technology was sealed away...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Indeed. The hasty spread of technology brought many tragedies.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You said you came looking for Lady Iris, %s. Then, regarding her...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: First, could you give me what you obtained?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. Here...
(You hand Loki's belongings to Sarasvati.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Only someone like Lady Iris could obtain this item.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I'm sorry, but I cannot tell you that. It is outside the permissions granted by the system. Opening a new protocol...
(Loki's belongings in Sarasvati's hand are drawn into the screen, as though absorbed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Incredible technology...)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Wait... What is this? %s, did you see anything besides Loki in D-Lab?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There were some strange children running around.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: So the unusual dimensional energy manifested in that form after all.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: %s, the only fully human people in this place are you, %s, and my sister Ishtar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then those children are...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: They are probably humans from another dimension's Jiendia, or another dimension's Asgard. The only person who can meet and speak with them now...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: ...is you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I really do that?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You followed Lady Iris all the way here. You are more than capable.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I would like you to meet them. You may not understand one another's language...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Take a device called a Mind Communicator to them. The beings in D-Lab should have one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will they agree to meet me?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If you can communicate, it should be all right.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Afterward, I will tell you what I intended to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. If I'm the only one who can do it, I'll try.
(The boy and girl you can speak with grow wary as %s approaches.)

lines.speaker: 언노운 소녀
lines.text: Greenie, be careful.

lines.speaker: 언노운 소년
lines.text: That person doesn't seem to want a fight. Am I right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I can understand them better as I get closer... I'll give them the Mind Communicator. Here, this... In my hand... Here...
(The boy watches %s's gestures and nods. The instant the Mind Communicator passes from %s's hand to his, your mind seems to clear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? It really works.

lines.speaker: 언노운 소년
lines.text: Oh, I can hear you. I understand you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah... We can understand each other!

lines.speaker: 언노운 소녀
lines.text: It's true! I can hear you! Amazing! It must be a translator.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm %s. I'd like to talk with you.

lines.speaker: 언노운 소년
lines.text: I knew that person wasn't a doppelganger!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A doppelganger?

lines.speaker: 언노운 소녀
lines.text: Oh, no time for that. Let me introduce myself. I'm Ruby!

lines.speaker: 언노운 소년
lines.text: I'm Kai.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: So, what shall we talk about? Delicious desserts?

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: Ruby, I don't think that's it. %s... What did you want to talk about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You came here looking for Iris too, right?

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: Who's Iris? Do you know, Ruby?

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Sorry, I've never heard that name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't know Iris? The Tyr girl who defeated the Demon King two years ago... I came here looking for her. Didn't you?

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: I don't think there was anyone like that in Lin's party...

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: There was Grand Duchess Trista of the Frost Castle, Sati the shaman, Ahyul the Sea Dragon King, Owen the Agasura Hunter, and Lin the Dragon Knight! That's everyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (All names I've never heard before...)

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Even children in the capital, [Parangis], know that story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parangis? Where's that...?

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: You don't know Parangis, the capital?

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: This conversation has been strange from the start.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Based on what Sara told us earlier, I have an idea. First, let me tell you about us.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: One day, we had a dream. A person named Owen was fighting the Demon King.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: They defeated the Demon King, but Lin, who had led the party until then, was badly wounded and captured by an Agasura.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: The others were about to fall to the Agasura too... But then! Can you believe it? The Demon King used the last of his strength to save everyone except Lin!

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: In truth, the Demon King had come to share Lin's feelings...

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: When the Demon King vanished, the balance of light and darkness broke, putting the world in danger of destruction. They say that's why we were summoned.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: I still clearly remember beginning our adventure in Belos Village, alongside countless other adventurers, to save Lin and Jiendia!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Belos... It sounds like the Belos I know, yet somehow it doesn't...)

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Everyone knows this story... You don't, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure. Then... This is confusing.

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: Oh, I get it!

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Yes, that must be it. Just as Sara said...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean we're people from different worlds, right?

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: Huh? Different worlds?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know about the Demon King and the Agasura, but your story is different right from Belos Village. I've never heard of any of the people Ruby mentioned.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me ask once more. Have you ever heard of Iris, Kazno, Muwen, Zoe, or Elias...?

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: No, I still don't recognize them...

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: As Sarasvati said, it seems parallel worlds are overlapping. Perhaps we're speaking through copies of <Unknowns> in different worlds whose frequencies are similar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah... So Sarasvati exists there too. I suppose I must look like an Unknown to you as well.

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: Ugh, it's complicated.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Kai, don't be like that. Try to understand.

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: Anyway, you're traveling to defeat an Agasura, right? And you're here for that girl Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. I'm looking for Iris... Huh?
(A hologram of Sarasvati appears before %s.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: %s, please... respond. Can you hear me? If beings from another world are with you, please do not tell them that I have contacted you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Oh, yes. I won't.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: %s, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, just a moment...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Please return immediately. Dimensional stability at your location is dropping rapidly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You could fall into a gap between time and space. This is extremely dangerous. Please leave at once.

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: ...Looks like something's happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, I think I need to go. This place...

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: We can tell that much. It looks like we should move too... But I hate to say goodbye.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Goodbye. Be careful, all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then take care, both of you... I hope we can meet again someday.

lines.speaker: 루비
lines.text: Goodbye! See you again!

lines.speaker: 카이
lines.text: Goodbye.
(As they say farewell, Ruby and Kai change from the forms of Unknowns into an innocent-looking boy and girl, then disappear.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Were those... their real appearances? In their world...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better hurry back to Sarasvati. Maybe I'll understand when I get there. What is this place...?

steps.name: Hell's Door
steps.objective: Talk to [Sarasvati] in the "Isolation Room", then enter "Hell's Door" and defeat [Hel]. After defeating [Hel], proceed to the next area.

lines.text: (In the strangely charged air of the compartment, Sarasvati concentrates on the characters moving across her screen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sarasvati, I'm back. Is everything all right now?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: For the moment, yes. And thank you for obtaining that valuable record of your conversation with them.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: A parallel world...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Is it something like a shadow of this world, or another world standing on equal footing with ours...?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I cannot say for certain, but this is the first time we have obtained such direct evidence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. It felt very strange. Speaking with people who live in another world I never knew existed...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: There is something else I need to tell you. About the doorway just ahead.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: At the passage connecting D-Lab and Yggdrasil, a powerful being from another dimension is blocking the entrance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Its power is strong enough to alter this world itself. For now, Record and Query are holding it back between them...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: ...We will need to keep watching the situation for the moment.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: We cannot afford to delay. The dimension is extremely unstable because of the world Loki came from...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If our world's spacetime stability deteriorates, it could cause a collision between our world and the worlds around it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...A c-collision? What would happen then?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: ...I cannot say. What is certain is that we must do something before it happens.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: That is why we need to restore Yggdrasil's facilities to normal.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: %s, please defeat [Hel], the goddess of the underworld at Hell's Door, and restore the area to normal.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Then perhaps... you may learn the answer you seek, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The answer I seek...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then wish me luck.
(In a place filled with an unknown, ominous power—a place aptly called hell—an unusual-looking woman waits for her guest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This place is like hell. That woman must be...

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: So the raven's child has come all the way here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think you've mistaken me for someone else...

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: You wish to protect that loathsome city of the gods. But I will not allow it.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: You should have died, struck by a branch! How are you still alive?!

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: No matter...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is she talking about?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Son of light, if you defy fate and stand against me, I will make you a subject of my realm with my own hands!

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: The final twilight of the world and its gods begins...!

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Hahahahahahaha!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Such terrifying power... But I can do this. I need answers. That's why I have to face you, even if nothing about this makes sense...
(%s's attacks bring Hel to a halt. The ominous energy filling the area seems to recede with her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Is it over?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Huh? What happened? My head feels clear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The atmosphere has changed... You...?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Thanks to you, I can think clearly again. Thank you.
(Hel approaches and kisses %s on the cheek.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Waaah! Y-you startled me! You can't just do that out of nowhere!

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: You aren't used to such things, are you? Hehe.
(The woman who seemed every inch a goddess of hell now smiles brightly, as though she has nothing to do with such a place.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...You're beautiful.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Thank you. I should have introduced myself sooner... I am Hel, the youngest of Loki's three children, the goddess destined to bring all things to an end.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: When a dimensional doorway suddenly opened and brought me here, I seem to have been possessed by a <spacetime worm> in the gap between worlds.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I'm sorry. I wasn't in my right mind for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then you didn't mean to fight just now?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Correct. In my own world, when the Twilight of the Gods comes, I am to proclaim the destruction of all things...

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: And guide the new humanity born in the age of renewal. That is my mission as a goddess. I do not act in places unrelated to it.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: The same is true of my siblings and our father, Loki. Perhaps that is why he went easy on you.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Hehe. Deceiver though Loki may be, he is the supreme god's brother. Until fate brings him down, no one can truly challenge him.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Though that, too, is a tale from our own world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In any case, I'm glad you're all right now.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Hehe, thank you. Now, brave young one, continue on your path. I shall wait until the dimension stabilizes, then return home.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I'll take my troublesome father and siblings with me, so don't worry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you very much.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: I am the one who should thank you for freeing a divine being from the shame of possession by a lowly worm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad you're a good person.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: We shall meet again, brave traveler.

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Confused though I was, how could I, queen of the underworld, mistake an ordinary human for the trueborn son of light...?

lines.speaker: 헬
lines.text: Hehe. I think I understand a little of the role that traveler has in this world...

steps.name: Opening the Door
steps.objective: Talk to the [Record & Query Brothers], then take the portal into the "Rift in Space-Time".

lines.text: (You enter a place where time seems to have stopped, and immediately feel an unfamiliar dissonance. Two strange young men draw your attention, barring the way.)
Please wait a moment.
Stop, stop! Better not come in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you...?

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: I am Record. This is my younger brother, Query...

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: We're the administrators of Yggdrasil. Though we're temporarily closed for business.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The ones Sarasvati mentioned... Oh, I'm %s.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: So you're the one she told us about. Welcome to Yggdrasil.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Query, mind your manners.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Oh, come on, this is fine. Hmm, what shall we talk about? You saved us, so I'll hear anything you have to say. As long as it isn't a confession of love!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to meet Iris. Iris... Oh, do you know someone called Iris?

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Of course. Miss Iris...

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: I see. So you're the adventurer who appeared in answer to Iris's call.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris's call...

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: First time I've seen you in person... Hmm, fascinating. How interesting.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: What is so interesting, Query? What will it take to make you behave?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, you two... Sarasvati said I could find the answer I wanted if I came here...

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: She wasn't wrong.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Yes. I don't know if it will be the answer you seek, but we can help. The space that Miss Iris reached...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then please tell me where its entrance is. Is that place Yggdrasil too? If you could give me permission to pass through...

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Ah, sorry about this. It's right here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: H-here?

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Yes. This is the entrance.
(Query raises his hand high.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean this place—the space itself...?

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Lady Hel thanked you for restoring her senses, %s, and agreed to cooperate with us.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: That should pose no difficulty, but restoring a dimension that has already been invaded is another matter.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: We'll need some time... Sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's beyond your control, it can't be helped.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: We are truly sorry... But we can promise you this.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: On our honor as brothers, we'll do everything we can to restore the doorway that stood here. So rest easy and wait just a little!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: We're the ones who should be thanking you. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Oh? It finished sooner than expected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: The dimension suddenly began stabilizing very quickly. This is...

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Should we call you a variable, or something like a virus?

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: It seems this is all because of you. Thanks to you, I mean.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: %s, a path to the space beyond opened once before... But we cannot say that it is the same now as it was then.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: Let me ask once more. Do you still wish to go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: I see your conviction.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: There. The doorway is open. Go forward. The answer you've been seeking...

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: Beyond that dimensional doorway, you'll meet someone who holds the answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll be going, then.

lines.speaker: 레코드
lines.text: May luck be with you.

lines.speaker: 쿼리
lines.text: From me, too...

translation.method: Fresh translation from the current Korean source
